metadata.description: Checks Rust formatting with the pinned toolchain.
Lints every Rust target with clippy, warnings denied.
Runs the Rust test suite with the locked dependency set.

wasm-repro.command: node --test crates/flows-jj/build-wasm.test.mjs && committed=$(mktemp) && cp packages/jj/wasm/flows_jj.wasm "$committed" && node crates/flows-jj/build-wasm.mjs && cmp "$committed" packages/jj/wasm/flows_jj.wasm

metadata.description: Rebuilds flows_jj.wasm from source and byte-compares it against the committed artifact. Only runs on x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu; build-wasm.mjs refuses any other host.
